# /sdd-new

Read `~/.codeium/windsurf/memories/global_rules.md` before any SDD-owned mutation. Follow its SDD Session Preflight, then its native dispatcher and init guards for `/sdd-new`. If that installed authority is missing, malformed, or cannot resolve the session, STOP; do not initialize, infer defaults, or recreate policy in this workflow.
